# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. State Cannon Foundry & Bore Standardization (National MIL Cabinet Action)
oe_mer2_cab_state_cannon_foundry = {
	ability = mil
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		num_locations >= 15
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		OR = {
			country_rank_level >= 3
			army_size >= 15
		}
	}

	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		num_locations >= 5
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_mer2_inject_capital_demand = { DEMAND = oe_mer2_cannon_foundry_demand YEARS = 2 }
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		army_artillery_build_cost_modifier = -0.15
		army_artillery_power = 0.08
		artillery_bonus_vs_fort = 1
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 16 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { at_war = yes } add = { value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { monthly_balance < 0 } subtract = { value = 20 } }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Standing Army Quartermaster & Supply Magazines (Provincial MIL Cabinet Action; explicit actor scope)
oe_mer2_cab_quartermaster_magazines = {
	ability = mil
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		num_locations >= 15
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		OR = {
			at_war = yes
			army_size >= 15
		}
	}

	allow = {
		is_subject = no
		num_locations >= 4
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_mer2_quartermaster_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_mer2_quartermaster_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_mer2_inject_capital_demand = { DEMAND = oe_mer2_quartermaster_supply_demand YEARS = 2 }
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		army_logistics_distance_modifier = 0.20
		army_maintenance_efficiency = 0.08
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.35
		local_food_capacity_modifier = 0.20
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 14 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = { limit = { at_war = yes } add = { value = 12 } }
			if = { limit = { stability < 0 } subtract = { value = 15 } }
		}
	}
}
